summary: Never-close rule gains one mechanical exception: the reconciler closes a CLI-opened PR whose content is byte-identical on main through a landed PR with the same task or decision id

options.description: reconciler closes CLI-opened, content-identical, superseded PRs through one audited entry point
every close stays with the operator

body: Operator ruling 2026-10-21 17:30Z. Humans inside process loops are a source of error (mistyped commands, non-deterministic follow-through); they are valuable for quality decisions. Closing a PR the CLI itself opened, whose every changed file is already byte-identical on main (per GitHub) through a landed PR with the same task or decision id, is bookkeeping, not a quality decision; today's #1813 and an adopter's #73 each needed three planner round-trips and an operator close. The exception is implemented by AISDLC-1011 as one audited CLI entry point; the hook keeps blocking the raw close subcommand; every other close stays operator-only.
